company.shortDescription: Carsabi is the search engine for used cars
company.description: Carsabi puts every car for sale online on one site - whether on a craigslist, dealership websites, speciality auto collections, or other classifieds. Our algorithms extract structured listings from every major online auto site to ensure you have the best deals on the web in real time. Quickly select a Make, Model, and other features and see any matching car in the US  - then compare on price vs mileage to quickly find the best deal.
